title: KBM - Lets do an accessibility pass
summary: Scope a maintainer accessibility pass for Keyboard Manager editor v2; no individual accessibility defect has yet been reported.
next_action: Run the bounded v2 keyboard/Narrator audit, then split confirmed defects into small fixes.

judgment.rationale: The request is valid maintenance work but does not yet establish a concrete product defect or root cause. Approve an audit scope and collect maintainers' results first.
evidence: The reporter requests an accessibility pass for Keyboard Manager interface v2 on the current GitHub build, without naming a failing control or assistive-technology scenario.
There are no discussion comments, attachments, or cross-referenced fixes in the retrieved issue timeline.
Inspected MainWindow.xaml, Pages/MainPage.xaml, Controls/UnifiedMappingControl.xaml and Controls/KeyDropDownButton.xaml at a pinned upstream revision.

MainPage contains mapping-list templates, enable toggles, action menus and create/delete dialogs; some controls already expose AutomationProperties.Name or AutomationId. Existing metadata must be tested rather than replaced speculatively: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/a9fd27873110a8a535ba607bef6470d643cadbc8/src/modules/keyboardmanager/KeyboardManagerEditorUI/Pages/MainPage.xaml

The key dropdown contains a search field and ListView; keyboard reachability, current selection and focus restoration require a live accessibility audit: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/a9fd27873110a8a535ba607bef6470d643cadbc8/src/modules/keyboardmanager/KeyboardManagerEditorUI/Controls/KeyDropDownButton.xaml
Direct issue-number/fork searches found no covering work. Focused accessibility history includes the older #6672 and #49287, but neither establishes that all new-editor surfaces have been audited.
judgment.recommended_action: Run the bounded v2 keyboard/Narrator audit, then split confirmed defects into small fixes.

information_gaps.information: A maintainer-owned accessibility defect inventory for the v2 editor
information_gaps.why_needed: No specific failure or acceptance baseline is supplied; this determines which controls actually need changes.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Run the numbered keyboard/Narrator audit in the reproduction action and record control, input, expected announcement/focus and observed result for each failure.

proposed_fixes.title: Audit v2 keyboard and screen-reader access
proposed_fixes.root_cause: No failing control is identified. The working hypothesis is that some dynamic row, popup or dialog surfaces may need explicit names, state announcements or focus restoration; each must be confirmed.
plan: Audit search/filter, mapping list, per-row enable/menu actions, key picker, create dialog and delete confirmation with keyboard-only navigation and Narrator.
For each confirmed failure, trace the accessible name, role/state and focus behavior to the relevant MainPage or control XAML/code-behind; preserve already-correct metadata.
Make only localized, localizable name/state/focus changes demonstrated by the audit; add regression coverage for the confirmed control instead of redesigning the editor.
Keep remapping engine behavior and shortcut interception unchanged.
verification: Reach and operate every audited action without a pointer; Escape closes transient UI and restores logical focus.
Narrator announces distinct row context, current key/shortcut and enabled/disabled state.
Repeat in Light, Dark and High Contrast and at increased text scale; no clipped essential labels or invisible focus.

confidence.rationale: Source identifies concrete audit surfaces, but neither the issue nor a runtime audit establishes that a particular fix is necessary.

reproduce.title: Audit v2 remap list, picker and dialogs
reproduce.version_requirement: Current build containing editor v2; record the exact build
prerequisites: Use disposable test data; preserve existing user configuration
setup: Use an isolated test profile with one key mapping, one shortcut mapping and one disabled mapping.
Enable Narrator and retain the existing remapping configuration separately.
steps: 1. Open editor v2 from Settings and use Tab/Shift+Tab through search, filters, selection mode and each remapping row.
2. Invoke New remapping by keyboard; open and search the trigger and action key pickers, choose keys, and cancel/save the dialog.
3. Toggle a test mapping, open its row menu, invoke/cancel delete and bulk-delete confirmation; check Narrator name, state and focus return.
4. Repeat with High Contrast and enlarged text; record only concrete accessibility failures with the control identity and exact input.
reproduce.expected_result: Every intended action is reachable, distinctly named and operable; focus remains visible and returns predictably. Record any counterexample before proposing a control-specific change.
reproduce.setup_prompt: Prepare disposable KBM mappings and an accessibility checklist for the named v2 controls; do not run remapping-engine stress tests or modify production mappings.

fix_assessment.rationale: A bounded audit-to-fix plan applies to the requested interface. No covering v2 accessibility implementation was identified; approve audit scope only before selecting code changes.
